title: getFirmCounters request
description: GET /v1/firms/{firmId}/counters - request. Aggregated counters of a firm per product (pending, declined, verifying).
$comment: Source: DISENO S3 (d) FirmCountersQuery, (e), (i) optional Redis cache, AP-I5; ADR-012; PRD RF-031. Audience: INTERNAL service-to-service - SX-01a family (S7 EngagementIndexClient). Residency: REGIONAL (cell of the firm); ENGAGEMENT_REGIONAL data never leaves the cell (RF-092, RF-093). Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (bounded: one entry per template/product).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
